name: Differentiable Shadow Kernel Sampling via Normal Distribution
aliases: Normal distribution kernel for shadow offset
definition: A method for importance sampling shadow offsets using a Normal distribution kernel in parameter space to enable differentiable path tracing.
summary: This differentiable importance sampling method generates shadow offsets by modeling the distribution as a Normal kernel, distinguished by its closed-form ICDF that ensures continuous, monotonically increasing probability density for gradient-based optimization.
